chunks: Then you will see it with the eye of certainty.
ai.seo_question: What does 'eye of certainty' mean in Surah Al-Takathur?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of 'Ayn al-Yaqin' (the eye of certainty), signifying the transition from intellectual faith to direct, experiential witnessing of divine justice. It serves as a powerful reminder that the trivialities of worldly accumulation will be revealed as empty distractions when confronted with the reality of the Hereafter.
